The intraprocedural rule does not follow this private typed close helper; whole SQL/fault fixtures and four added dual-fault cases verify the resource postcondition.

It loads no external driver or held application class, opens no network/DB and fails unexpected methods. This tests original exception identity at approved standard JDBC boundaries, outside an application-server context-loader contract.
